column3: The Hebrew says the king sent and they gathered all the elders to him; BSB condenses both actions into the king summoning them.
The Hebrew says all the people stood in the covenant; BSB says they entered into it.
The Hebrew uses the word houses for what the women wove for Asherah; BSB renders this as tapestries.
The Hebrew says they ate unleavened bread among their brothers; BSB identifies those brothers as fellow priests.
The Hebrew says causing a son or daughter to pass through the fire; BSB explicitly calls it sacrificing them.
The Hebrew says he filled their places with human bones; BSB says he covered the sites with them.

The Hebrew says the kings made the shrines to provoke anger and Josiah did to them everything he had done at Bethel; BSB recasts this as the kings having provoked the LORD and condenses the repeated actions.
The Hebrew begins in his days and says Neco went up against the king of Assyria; BSB specifies the end of Josiah’s reign and going to help Assyria.
